caption: A Zhi-khro mandala from the Bardo Thodol (Tibetan Book of the Dead) tradition.
alt: A brightly colored square Tibetan Buddhist mandala painting, concentric squares and circles in red, blue, gold, and green around a central deity figure.
credit: Wikimedia Commons, anonymous Tibetan work, tagged public domain
note: Leary, Metzner, and Alpert's book is still under copyright, so no page of it is used. This is a traditional Tibetan mandala from the Bardo Thodol -- the Tibetan Book of the Dead -- that their 1964 manual is explicitly based on; it is not a plate from their edition, but the same iconographic tradition. Artist and date unknown (traditional work, reproduced from an old painting).
